concepts.name: flat-cartoon
concepts.label: Flat cartoon
concepts.prompt:
Create ONE ultra-wide SHALLOW COVER image in 3:1 aspect ratio (2172x724 or similar), on a PURE WHITE canvas. Brand reference image 1 is the exact CyberAlchemy Lab LOGO: preserve this coral intertwined spiral emblem and black wordmark 'CyberAlchemy' with 'LAB' beneath, clean sharp faithful typography, as a modest lockup on the LEFT third centered vertically. Reference image 2 is the red ORB: reproduce its recognizable ruby-red sphere and gold-orange swirling vortex, adapted into the scene's illustration style. Do not insert white rectangles from reference files.
Right two-thirds: one whimsical invention FACTORY shown from OUTSIDE at a distant elevated three-quarter angle, entire building silhouette visible. An eccentric toy-maker's laboratory made of 8-12 distinct connected modules spread HORIZONTALLY: low workshop buildings, 2 short domed towers, one round greenhouse module, a round central glass chamber housing the red spiral orb, a squat annex, a suspended little pod, one mechanical crane, chunky crooked pipes, a bridge conveyor, exposed gear and a short spiraling chimney. Playful architecture and clear readable contraptions, no people. The red orb powers the modules and is integrated into the central building, about 12% of factory's width. Keep factory low, with all tallest parts fitting safely inside middle 65% of canvas height. Buildings in a long horizontal cluster, NOT a towering vertical castle. Lots of clean white negative space, completely white background, no sky, mountains, landscape, forests, scenery, floorplan, interior cutaway or extra text. No additional logo within factory. Warm cream, coral, teal and ochre palette. Design readable when banner is small. CRITICAL STYLE: TRUE FLAT CARTOON, radically simplified 2D animation illustration. Thick even dark outlines, bold simple shapes, solid flat color fills, NO gradients, NO rendered lighting, NO glossy 3D materials, NO brick texture, NO microdetail. Smooth rounded toy buildings with minimal windows. A friendly polished cartoon with sparse details, clear silhouette and graphic shapes. Orb represented as a RED circular emblem-like sphere with a sweeping ORANGE spiral, a few simple highlights. Factory should look like a carefully drawn flat cartoon, not realistic fantasy game art.

concepts.name: pixel-art
concepts.label: Pixel art
concepts.prompt: Create ONE very wide, shallow landscape cover banner, aspect ratio 3:1, ideally 2400 by 800 pixels. This is an adaptation of the attached CyberAlchemy Lab factory cover for restricted-height headers. Reference 1 is the factory concept and brand placement; Reference 2 is the actual logo lockup. Preserve the logo mark's coral color, recognizable interlocking elliptical spiral shape, black 'CyberAlchemy' wordmark and uppercase spaced 'LAB' beneath, in a crisp professional brand treatment identical across styles. Only this brand text, correctly spelled. Use a pure white canvas with generous negative space. Place the logo lockup in the LEFT third of the banner, centered vertically, about 27% of total width, with generous margins. Place the factory in the RIGHT two-thirds, fully visible at a distance from an elevated exterior three-quarter angle. Rebuild its silhouette as a LONG LOW sprawling horizontal cluster of connected buildings rather than a tall stack: modules side by side, short towers, squat domes, low workshops, small hanging pods, glass experiment rooms, pipes, gear housings, cranes, conveyor bridges and rooftop contraptions. All objects fit within the shallow frame with white margins above and below. Full uncut architectural silhouette, no tall spires or multi-storey vertical pile. Keep details large enough to read when the cover is shown at 240 pixels high. The recognizable ruby-red orb with an orange-gold swirling vortex is integrated inside a round glass housing at the center of the factory, powering the attached modules. A playful eccentric toy-inventor's laboratory, one coherent connected complex with clear visual rhythm across the width. Warm cream, coral, teal and brass-yellow accents, glowing ruby orb. White background only, minimal soft grounding shadow if appropriate, no sky or scenic environment, no trees surrounding the factory, no interior cutaway, no floor plan, no additional text. Do not make a standard 16:9 poster; this must be a panoramic SHALLOW 3:1 HEADER. STYLE: PIXEL ART. Beautifully crafted colorful 16-bit-inspired building sprites arranged as one coherent long factory, precise crisp pixel clusters and outlines, warm cream walls, teal/coral roofs, brass pipes, small toy machinery, bright red spiral orb. Distant exterior three-quarter game-art view, clean silhouettes rather than a dense game map. White background, no game HUD, no scenery. Factory is intentionally pixelated; brand logo and wordmark remain smooth and sharp, matching the supplied logo exactly.
